title: Hook
line: When a lead on a sales call asks you the price…
visual: YOUR PRICE ISN'T / THE PROBLEM. White kicker + big yellow headline with a hand-drawn underline. Camera pushed in from the top so the title owns the top third.
motion: Kicker words blur in one by one (0.08s stagger); headline words blur-scale in; underline draws left to right. Exits upward with blur at 4.7s.

title: Price vs value
line: …and it feels very expensive for them to take a decision.
visual: Thin line-art balance scale behind the speaker's head. A yellow PRICE weight drops into the left pan; the VALUE pan is empty (dashed). Serif note: feels expensive.  A yellow ? appears by the empty pan.
motion: Scale draws in; PRICE drops on 'quote a price'; beam tips 9° then 14° on 'expensive' with a soft overshoot; punch-in on 'expensive'.

title: Series tile
line: Welcome to Coach Meet Business Series
visual: Paper tile: ep. 03 big top-right; coach meet / business / series (blue bar) bottom-left. Same tile as ep.01/02 for series consistency.
motion: Hard cut in; 03 rises; words land on the spoken word; tile wipes up to reveal the speaker.

title: 1 crore
line: …what it takes to build a one crore coaching business.
visual: WHAT IT TAKES TO BUILD A (justified) / ₹1 CRORE (yellow) / coaching business. (serif).
motion: Each kicker word appears on its spoken word; ₹1 CRORE blur-scales in on 'one crore'.

title: The call
line: …you quote that price, and it feels very expensive for them to take an action.
visual: Dialogue in the label-column grammar: THE LEAD “what's the price?” → YOU [₹ ••,•••] → THE LEAD “…that's expensive.” Thin rule separates speaker from words.
motion: Rule draws down; each line arrives on its spoken moment; earlier lines dim to 45% when “expensive” lands.

title: The missing value
line: …they are not able to understand the value you are trying to deliver.
visual: The scale returns, still tipped to PRICE. The empty VALUE pan lights up yellow. Serif: they can't see it.
motion: Scale fades back in already tipped (continuity); VALUE outline turns yellow and pulses twice on 'value'.

title: The life after
line: …not able to depict the life they will achieve once they go through the transformation
visual: THEY CAN'T PICTURE / the life after. (large yellow serif).
motion: Kicker words on 'they're… depict'; serif line blur-scales in on 'life'.

title: B-roll: iceberg
line: …not just from the physical level, but from a psychological level as well.
visual: Full-screen graphic cutaway. Dark page, blue water. Small white tip above the waterline = PHYSICAL (what they see); huge yellow mass below = PSYCHOLOGICAL (what they feel).
motion: Page slides up from below; waterline draws; tip outlines on 'physical'; the deep mass draws slower and bigger on 'psychological'; page slides away up.

title: Value to price
line: Values should be understood really well before you quote a price.
visual: THE RIGHT ORDER: [01 VALUE] → [02 PRICE] + serif: before you quote a price.
motion: VALUE pill pops on 'values'; arrow draws on 'before'; PRICE slides in on 'quote a price'.

title: Point A to point B
line: Your consulting happens to be the best mechanism to go from point A to point B.
visual: Bridge diagram: A (where they are · pain, crisis) and B (yellow · the dream). A dashed arc joins them with a blue YOUR CONSULTING pill on top; a yellow line + dot travel A→B.
motion: A pops on 'point A', B on 'dream point'; arc draws on 'your consulting'; dot rides the arc on 'point A to point B'; B pulses on arrival.

title: If to then
line: …then and only then you open the landscape for the pricing discussion.
visual: IF  value is seeded in their mind ✓ / THEN  the pricing discussion opens (yellow).
motion: Rows arrive on 'if' and 'only then'; check draws on 'mind'; the THEN row is closed (two halves) and slides open on 'open the platform' to reveal the yellow pill.

title: Compared on price
line: …you will always be getting compared to the price.
visual: The scale returns one last time, tipping further to PRICE. Serif: compared on price.
motion: Callback of the opening construction; beam drops to 18° with a punch-in on 'compared'.

title: CTA
line: Comment value, and I'll be sending you a workbook…
visual: COMMENT THE WORD / [V][A][L][U][E] yellow keys / serif: & I'll send you the workbook.
motion: Kicker words on 'comment'; keys drop in one after another (0.07s) with a soft bounce; serif line blurs in on 'sending'.
